visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Inside a modern vehicle, a woman with dark hair wearing a denim and white-striped jacket sits in the passenger seat while a man in a grey sweater and black beanie drives. The lighting is natural and bright from the windows, showing a clear day outside. (2) The camera switches to a scenic POV shot of a Korean highway surrounded by mountains under a clear blue sky. A navigation screen is shown with a winding green route, followed by a bright street scene at a red light with trees nearby. (3) The scene transitions to a white-bordered photo of a parking space on a road with yellow lines and numbered markings. Mountains and power lines are visible in the background, along with a bright red warning siren graphic overlaid on screen. (4) A close-up shows the woman talking directly to the camera while wearing a white furry winter hat. She uses hand gestures to explain gas station types. The background is the interior of the car while they are parked at a station. (5) A screen recording of the Naver Map application is displayed, showing gas station prices and locations in Korea. The interface is in Korean with icons for fuel types and prices, demonstrating how to save money on gasoline. (6) The video concludes back in the car with the two main characters. They are both smiling and waving towards the camera. The woman is gesturing with her hands while text overlays encourage viewers to leave comments.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 臺灣人在韓國自駕. (2) [Subtitle]: 會變成三寶?! (3) [Subtitle]: 肉比頭發現的驚人駕駛文化差異! (4) [Variety]: 1. [Subtitle]: 你知道在韓國開車是可以紅燈右轉的嗎? (5) [Logo]: 紅燈右轉. [Subtitle]: 只要記得禮讓行人, 確定安全後再右轉就好. (6) [Subtitle]: 但我跟阿翔一開始還不適應或是偶爾會忘記, 還傻傻的在路上等. (7) [Subtitle]: 那當然馬上就被後車“溫柔”地提醒了. (8) [Subtitle]: 所以大家在過馬路也要小心喔! (9) [Variety]: 2. [Subtitle]: 有些路上的停車格是有寫數字的耶! (10) [Logo]: 停車格數字. [Subtitle]: 問了路人才知道, 其實這都是跟政府申請的私人停車位! (11) [Subtitle]: 下次看到不可以亂停喔! 是有可能會被拖吊的. (12) [Variety]: 3. [Subtitle]: 韓國的加油站分為無鉛汽油 & 柴油兩種. (13) [Logo]: 韓國加油. [Subtitle]: 不像台灣分為92/95/98, 所以加油無腦選汽油就好. (14) [Logo]: 韓國加油. [Subtitle]: * 建議加油前先向租車行確認! (15) [Subtitle]: 但是很特別的來了, 網路上甚至有分享, 就在隔壁的加油站, 每公升可以差到20塊台幣這麼多誒! (16) [Subtitle]: 好險韓國的APP也很貼心, 在Naver Map上面也會直接秀出當下的油價. (17) [Subtitle]: 先從手機查價錢之後再前往那個加油站, 就不會花了很多冤枉錢! (18) [Subtitle]: 你也想去韓國自駕, 有哪些想問的問題也可以留言跟我們討論喔! (19) [Logo]: 肉比頭 台灣國外冷知識系列 持續更新中~
